nb7100c1340.headline: The Bolloré group in difficulty, its accounts seized in Burkina Faso
nb7100c1340.summary: French conglomerate Bolloré group faced a setback as three subsidiaries were ordered to pay over 14.6 billion FCFA in compensation in a dispute with Burkinabe businessman Mohamed Sogli.
nb7100c1340.why: Bolloré is a major player in African logistics and infrastructure; legal rulings can affect its operations and financials in the region.
